name: @apifreaks/mcp
description: The official MCP server for APIFreaks — real-time Weather, WHOIS, DNS, SSL, IP intelligence, currency, domain checks, screenshots, and more.

apiKey.title: APIFreaks API Key
apiKey.description: Your APIFreaks API key. Get one free at apifreaks.com.

tools.name: weather_current
tools.description: Get real-time weather for a location, including temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, air quality (AQI), and astronomy data.

tools.name: weather_bulk_current
tools.description: Get real-time weather for up to 50 locations at once.

tools.name: weather_forecast
tools.description: Get weather forecast for up to 16 days with daily, hourly, or minutely precision.

tools.name: weather_historical
tools.description: Get historical weather data for a specific past date (back to 1940).

tools.name: weather_time_series
tools.description: Get historical weather data over a date range. Max 90 days daily, 7 days hourly.

tools.name: weather_air_quality
tools.description: Get real-time or forecast air quality — PM2.5, PM10, CO, NO₂, SO₂, ozone, dust, and UV index.

tools.name: weather_marine
tools.description: Get marine/ocean weather, real-time or forecast up to 16 days — waves, swell, wind, sea-surface data.

tools.name: weather_flood_forecast
tools.description: Get flood forecast data — river discharge and flow percentiles up to 16 days ahead.

tools.name: currency_latest_rates
tools.description: Retrieve the latest exchange rates for 170+ fiat currencies and 830+ cryptocurrencies.

tools.name: currency_historical_rates
tools.description: Retrieve historical exchange rates for a specific past date.

tools.name: currency_latest_converter
tools.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another using the latest exchange rates.

tools.name: currency_historical_converter
tools.description: Convert an amount between currencies using exchange rates from a specific past date.

tools.name: currency_time_series
tools.description: Retrieve historical exchange rates day-by-day across a custom date range (max 1 year).

tools.name: currency_fluctuation
tools.description: Retrieve exchange rate fluctuation metrics — start rate, end rate, absolute and percent change.

tools.name: currency_geo_convert
tools.description: Convert an amount to the local currency of an IP address's location.

tools.name: currency_supported
tools.description: Get the full list of supported currencies with code, name, country data, and status.

tools.name: currency_symbols
tools.description: Get a map of supported currency symbols to currency names.

tools.name: currency_symbol_info
tools.description: Validate a currency symbol and return its full name.

tools.name: ipgeolocation_lookup
tools.description: Look up geolocation, network/ASN, currency, and security data for an IP address or hostname.

tools.name: ipgeolocation_bulk_lookup
tools.description: Look up geolocation data for up to 50,000 IP addresses or hostnames in one request.

tools.name: whois_domain_lookup
tools.description: Retrieve live WHOIS data for a domain — registrar, contacts, name servers, and expiry dates.

tools.name: whois_ip_lookup
tools.description: Retrieve live WHOIS ownership and network data for an IPv4 or IPv6 address.

tools.name: whois_asn_lookup
tools.description: Retrieve real-time WHOIS data for an ASN — name, org, routes, and peers.

tools.name: whois_domain_history
tools.description: Retrieve historical WHOIS snapshots for a domain, with data going back to 1986.

tools.name: whois_reverse_lookup
tools.description: Search WHOIS records in reverse to find all domains linked to an owner, email, company, or keyword.

tools.name: whois_bulk_domain_lookup
tools.description: Retrieve live WHOIS data for up to 100 domain names in one request.

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Retrieve real-time DNS records for a hostname — A, AAAA, MX, NS, SOA, SPF, TXT, CNAME.

tools.name: dns_history
tools.description: Retrieve historical DNS record snapshots for a hostname.

tools.name: dns_reverse
tools.description: Find all hostnames associated with a specific DNS record value — reverse IP, MX, NS, and more.

tools.name: dns_bulk_lookup
tools.description: Retrieve real-time DNS records for up to 100 hostnames at once.

tools.name: domain_check_availability
tools.description: Check whether a domain name is available for registration.

tools.name: domain_check_availability_with_suggestions
tools.description: Check domain availability and get alternative suggestions across different TLDs.

tools.name: domain_bulk_check_availability
tools.description: Check domain availability for up to 100 domains at once.

tools.name: ssl_live_lookup
tools.description: Retrieve the live SSL certificate for a domain — validity, issuer, SANs, and PEM output.

tools.name: ssl_live_chain_lookup
tools.description: Retrieve the complete SSL certificate chain including intermediates and root CA.

tools.name: commodity_symbols
tools.description: List all supported commodity symbols with name, unit, quote currency, and exchange.

tools.name: commodity_symbol_info
tools.description: Validate a commodity symbol and return its full metadata.

tools.name: commodity_quotes
tools.description: List all supported commodity quote currencies.

tools.name: commodity_latest_rates
tools.description: Get real-time prices for one or more commodities.

tools.name: commodity_historical_rates
tools.description: Get historical OHLC prices for commodities on a specific date.

tools.name: commodity_fluctuation
tools.description: Get price fluctuation metrics for commodities over a date range.

tools.name: commodity_time_series
tools.description: Get daily OHLC prices for commodities over a date range (max 365 days).

tools.name: zipcode_lookup
tools.description: Look up a ZIP or postal code — city, region, country, and coordinates.

tools.name: zipcode_bulk_lookup
tools.description: Look up details for up to 100 ZIP or postal codes at once.

tools.name: zipcode_radius_search
tools.description: Find all ZIP codes within a given radius of a center point.

tools.name: zipcode_distance
tools.description: Calculate the distance from a base point to each of up to 100 ZIP codes.

tools.name: zipcode_distance_match
tools.description: Find all pairs of ZIP codes within a given distance threshold.

tools.name: zipcode_by_city
tools.description: Get all ZIP or postal codes for a city.

tools.name: zipcode_by_region
tools.description: Get all ZIP or postal codes for a state, province, or region.

tools.name: timezone_lookup
tools.description: Look up timezone info for a location — accepts IP, city, lat/long, IATA, ICAO, or UN/LOCODE.

tools.name: timezone_convert
tools.description: Convert a date and time from one timezone to another.

tools.name: screenshot_capture
tools.description: Capture a static screenshot of a webpage and return the image URL.

tools.name: screenshot_capture_scrolling
tools.description: Record a scrolling video or animated GIF of a webpage.

tools.name: screenshot_bulk_capture
tools.description: Capture screenshots of up to 50 webpages in a single request.

tools.name: user_agent_parse
tools.description: Parse a user-agent string to extract browser, device, OS, and engine details.

tools.name: user_agent_bulk_parse
tools.description: Parse up to 100 user-agent strings in a single request.

tools.name: astronomy_lookup
tools.description: Get astronomy data for a location and date — sunrise, sunset, moon phase, twilight, golden hour, and more.
